claims.head: The Maple Leafs got an upgrade
claims.body: Taken over this season and last, the Maple Leafs are near the bottom of the league for shot volume. Look at this season alone, though, and they’ve been shooting more, around the middle. We think tonight looks more like this season’s Maple Leafs.
claims.nums: Shot volume: 24th over two seasons (score 96), 14th this season (score 101)
claims.gist: The Maple Leafs aren’t the team you remember for shot volume.
claims.call: The Maple Leafs’ shot volume score is above their blended level of 96.
claims.see: About 46 shot attempts at 5-on-5 the way they’ve played this season, against 44 at their blended level.

claims.head: Bobrovsky’s hold on the Golden Knights won’t last
claims.body: Bobrovsky has been a wall against the Golden Knights since 2023-24, well above his usual. But three seasons of data say a goalie’s record against one team tells us nothing about the next meeting, so don’t be surprised if Bobrovsky isn’t that wall tonight.
claims.nums: 5 starts against Vegas: .937 save percentage · .899 against everyone else
claims.gist: Don’t read much into Bobrovsky’s record against the Golden Knights.
claims.call: If Bobrovsky starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .899 than to his .937 against the Golden Knights.

claims.head: The Golden Knights’ power play has a target
claims.call: The Golden Knights’ power play creates at least their usual 9.2 expected goals per 60.
claims.body: The Golden Knights’ power play is one of the league’s best, and the Maple Leafs’ kill is one of the worst. Every trip to the box hurts the Maple Leafs more than most.

VGK.head: The Golden Knights should be in control
VGK.body: Vegas has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. It’s on the Maple Leafs to make it a game, and they can if their power play gets going.

TOR.head: The Golden Knights should be favored
TOR.body: Vegas has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. To pull this off, the Maple Leafs can start with a power play that gets going, plus Sergei Bobrovsky stealing the show.
